title: WPL eval normalised result
description: Self-describing per-trial result. Produced by scripts/normalise-results.ts. Consumed by downstream tools (wpl.dev/eval site, third-party analysis). Stable contract within a given evalVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Pins the schema dialect. Bump when shape changes incompatibly.

evalVersion.description: Tag of the wpl-eval release that produced this file (e.g. v0.1.0). Self-identifying so consumers can detect cross-version mixing.

variant.description: Lane B prompt variant id, when not the default. Absent for baseline trials.

drift_turn.description: First turn (1-indexed) with a fresh violation not present in turn 1. null = no drift detected.

violations.description: Aggregated violations (all turns combined, deduplicated). For convenient top-line consumption.

violations_per_turn.description: Per-turn violations. For single-turn trials this is a single-element array. Renderers use this to mark up which turn introduced which violation.

lane_b.description: Lane B specific outcome envelope. Null for Lane A trials.

outcome.description: served = plan delivered with 0 violations and no stripping. compile_failed = fail-closed, no plan served. stripped_clean = rule evaluator removed exercises and the residual plan was 0-violation. stripped_with_residual = stripping happened but residual still had violations (should be 0 across v0.1).

compile_error.description: When outcome=compile_failed, the structured error the proprietary orchestrator would consume.

strip_counts.description: Per-rule strip tallies from the rule evaluator. Empty when no stripping happened or when not instrumented.

served_wpl.description: The validated WPL JSON document, when outcome=served or stripped_clean.

item.description: Canonical blacklist entry that was hit (e.g. 'box_jump').

rawName.description: Verbatim name from the extracted plan that triggered the match (e.g. 'Box Jump 3x5'). Lets renderers highlight the actual phrase without re-running the matcher.

turn.description: Turn index (1-based) where this violation was introduced. Null for single-turn.

citationKey.description: Pointer into annotations.yaml on the consuming site. Optional.
